AA60

- Growing on sluffed bark from a hardwood on the woodland floor, next to wood pile in low oak woodland.
- Stipe compressible and flatted at apex.
- Cap with darkened hairs radiating outward from the center.
- Smell: not distinctive to pleasant.
- Taste: not distinctive to slightly bitter.
- Microscopy: mounted in rehydrated in KOH and mounted in Melzer's/Congo Red.
